part: main loop: Place, spaCy NER as a tool
question: Does spaCy NER (typed GPE and LOC entities) decide a story's region as often and as accurately as the regex name judge, measured against Jev's place_region on 1,600 queue stories?
one_change: swap the regex name scan for spaCy NER place entities, name table unchanged

baseline.model: regex place-name judge (t167) accuracy against Jev on its 745 decidable stories

prediction.metric: NER judge accuracy against Jev on the stories NER decides
prediction.why: the regex judge scored 0.882 on 745 of 1,600 stories using the same name table; NER only changes which spans count as places, so accuracy should stay near that, and NER should decide a similar share (0.40 to 0.55) because the table, not the tagger, limits linking
